PR.body:
## Why
NCP PHYS07 preserved a directional witness as OPEN because its per-node heat condition fails at node 32, even though aggregate source directions can still be strictly cooling.

## What changes
Adds a separate PHYS08 research package with the weighted balance B = p v_w − w(v_x + fhat v_y1 + 2 fhat v_y2), derived from the same fixed-coefficient source. Exact rational postprocessing of all 33×3 signed rate enclosures certifies cooling and source-level HH/photo competition for full and same-COMMON first-half, separately for physical P_N and birth derivative P_M. Original node32 OPEN outputs and all tails remain unchanged.

Includes source provenance, captured inputs, exact outputs, an independently reviewed Rust scalar gate candidate, golden fixtures, a strict output consumer, bounded NCP wrapper and an attachment-free handoff.

## Evidence and scope
Independent noncreator decision: PROMOTE_SCOPED. Corrected Python reference passed in 0.368 s; first reflected-division implementation failure, source snapshot and targeted correction are preserved. 294 assertions cover four source-role cases and seven semantic cases, yielding 11 golden fixtures. No source/provider/solver or historical scientific replay.

Rust and the NCP wrapper/consumer are READY_NOT_RUN because rustc/cargo are absent on the research host. Native root/U/V/W/I, finite energy interaction, carry/paired/time/continuum, full49 and production remain OPEN. Dual-backup identities will be attached in a separate delivery commit; no merge or runtime installation is performed.
